create_EMAHook: create an EMAHook instance to apply exponential moving average on model parameters during training
configure_EMAHook_evaluation: configure EMAHook with evaluate_on_ema and evaluate_on_origin to validate on both EMA and original models
use_before_train: use the before_train method to initialize source model parameters from EMA checkpoint when not resuming training
use_after_load_checkpoint: use the after_load_checkpoint method to resume EMA parameters from a saved checkpoint with ema_state_dict
review_EMAHook_swap_parameters: review the EMAHook before_val_epoch and after_val_epoch methods that swap EMA and source model parameters during validation
